title.zh: ⚡️Metaplanet获批控股纳斯达克上市公司SLE，成功实现在美上市布局
title.en: ⚡️Metaplanet获批控股纳斯达克上市公司SLE，成功实现在美上市布局

current_state.zh: Metaplanet won shareholder approval to take ~95.7% control of Nasdaq-listed Super League Enterprise by injecting 2,100 BTC and $2.5M cash (~$134.6M total), establishing a US-listed Bitcoin treasury platform alongside its Japanese operations.
